headline: ECLAC says pensions in the DR have little impact on reducing poverty
summary: ECLAC finds that pensions in the Dominican Republic have a limited effect on poverty reduction. The country's population aged over 65 is set to grow substantially by 2050.
why: Pension adequacy shapes household consumption, fiscal pressure and long-term labour-market and social-spending decisions in the Dominican economy.
original_headline: Cepal señala pensiones en RD inciden poco en reducir la pobreza
